title: What qualities should I look for in a good occupational therapist?
metaTitle: Qualities to Look for in a Great Occupational Therapist at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover what makes a great occupational therapist. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, our therapists are patient, creative, flexible, and experts in working with children with autism.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we believe that a significant therapist possesses certain qualities that allow them to best support your child's needs. A few of these qualities comprise of patience, creativity, flexibility, and a strong breadth of knowledge regarding diverse therapeutic strategies. They must excel in communication and be adept at tuning into the unique needs of each child. Most importantly, they should hold an in-depth understanding and compassion for the journey faced by children with autism.
